correctness.rationale: Block decomposition E=diag(1,0) is legitimate over any field. The polynomial and nilpotency claims follow from bd=a(1-a); incidence double counting proves trace-conditioned T(a). At a=0,1 the matrix equations enumerate c=0,1 independently, and c=2 is the disjoint complement. Numerical exhaustive tests verify every cell for six small prime-field instances; general proof does not rely on tests.

value.rationale: The exact joint trace/commutator-rank/similarity counts are structurally motivated invariants of two matrix idempotents, and determine complete distributions for every dimension, every rank of the second factor and every finite field. This refines a classical coarse enumeration and resolves nilpotent-index frequency, including the sharp field-order-two dichotomy; it is more than a substitution into a rank-only table.
